acceptanceCriteria: Region response is strictly validated; cache age is at most 72 hours; no locale/time-zone inference exists; every ambiguous/error/offline/stale path disables SDK initialization and ad requests.
Protected-region consent is bound to policyVersion, restored only when fresh/matching, invalidated on version change, and withdrawal prevents new requests immediately.
Yandex SDK initialization occurs only after an eligible privacy decision and setUserConsent is applied before each permitted initialization.
Only one inline slot can render on Catalog and History; all other screens/states, previews and tests are prohibited; no fullscreen/sticky/rewarded/app-open/mediation formats exist.
Android debug uses official test configuration and release refuses placeholders/missing IDs; iOS remains safe-disabled because no iOS ad project/unit exists.
Tests cover region success/failure/malformed/stale, consent create/restore/withdraw/version change, placement limits, load/failure/retry/disposal and iOS disabled state.
Templates/docs identify only external remaining actions: Android ad unit, final privacy URL, approved localized copy and device verification; no external objects are created.
goal: Implement the canonical privacy region endpoint client and strict validation, 72-hour cache, policyVersion-bound consent state machine, privacy-before-SDK initialization, setUserConsent before every permitted initialization, approved inline placement policy (Catalog and History only, maximum one), lifecycle-safe Android Yandex banner adapter with debug test ID and release real-ID guard, and unconditional iOS safe-disabled no-ID adapter. Network/malformed/stale/unknown/withdrawn states fail closed while the offline core remains available. Add deterministic MockEngine/privacy/ad lifecycle tests and external-only templates/docs for Android ad unit, final privacy URL and approved EN/RU consent/disclosure copy. No live IDs, project creation, analytics, attribution, mediation or prohibited formats.
